mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 1.5% in a single month, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and reduces valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate deteriorating consumer demand that reduces corporate revenue growth prospects, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals imminent labor market deterioration that reduces corporate hiring and profit growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines in low unemployment regime, or signal Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates strengthening manufacturing output that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 in a monthly reading, it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and core inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals aggressive monetary tightening to combat inflation, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint rise in FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a high consumer spending regime (RSAFS > 500,000), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals retreat in the housing sector that reduces overall consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST declines in high consumer spending regime, or signal Rank IC falls below 0.03.
